seoTitle: Casa Rustica · Cosy holiday home in De Haan for up to 10 guests
seoDescription: Rent Casa Rustica, a warm family holiday home in De Haan on the Belgian coast: 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a sunny garden, pets welcome and a short walk from the beach.
heroAlt: Casa Rustica, a white villa with a red-tiled roof in De Haan
title: Your cosy home by the sea
description: A warm, characterful family house with a sunny garden, a short walk from the beach. Room for up to 10 guests, and for four-legged friends too.
about: A house that feels like coming home
aboutDescription: Tucked away in a quiet, leafy street in De Haan, Casa Rustica is the kind of place where holidays slow down. Morning coffee on the terrace, sandy feet after a day at the beach, long dinners around the big family table.
aboutDescription2: We furnished the house the way we love to live: classic black-and-white tiles, antique wood, soft sofas and plenty of light, with every modern comfort quietly in place. It's a home, not a hotel, and you'll feel it the moment you open the door.
aboutSignature: We can't wait to welcome you.
readingCornerAlt: A cosy reading corner in the living room
badgeLabel: The whole house and garden, just for you
spacesDescription: From the first cup of coffee to the last board game of the night, every room is made to be shared.
livingDescription: Checkered floors, an antique cabinet and a long wooden table for ten: this is the heart of the house. Sink into the corner sofa with a good book, or let the evening drift on with good food and good company.
kitchenDescription: Fully equipped and full of light, with everything you need to cook for the whole family, from pancakes on a lazy Sunday to fresh fish from the North Sea.
bedroomsDescription: Four bedrooms, each with its own colour and character, sleep up to ten guests. Fresh sea air, comfortable beds and a quiet street: a good night's sleep comes naturally here.
gardenDescription: The private garden and covered terrace call you outside. Fire up the barbecue, let the kids run around on the lawn, or simply soak up the late-afternoon sun.
highlightsDescription: We've taken care of the details so you can focus on what matters: rest, fresh sea air and time with the people you love.
beachDescription: A short walk takes you to De Haan's wide sandy beach for sunny days, sandcastles and bracing seaside walks.
outdoorDescription: A private, sunny garden with a covered terrace, perfect for barbecues and lazy afternoons.
familyDescription: Cots, board games and plenty of space, so little ones and grandparents both feel at home.
petsDescription: Your dog is part of the family, so they're welcome on holiday too.
kitchenEquippedDescription: Oven, hob, coffee machine and everything you need to cook for the whole group.
wifiDescription: Wi-Fi, a TV and a 24-inch monitor, for film nights or the occasional email.
surroundingsDescription: Cycle through the dunes, hop on the coastal tram, or spend a day in Bruges or Ostend.
tourismDescription: Recognised under the Flemish Lodging Decree, and meets every comfort and fire-safety standard.
ctaTitle: The sea is calling, and so is the house

contactDescription: Would you like a price for your dates, or have a question about the house or bringing the dog? Send us a message and we'll get back to you personally.

locationTitle: De Haan, where the dunes meet the sea
locationDescription: Belle Époque villas, wide sandy beaches and wooded dunes: De Haan is one of the most charming and peaceful villages on the Belgian coast. Casa Rustica sits on a quiet residential street, close to everything yet away from the crowds.
nearbyBeachDescription: A short walk or bike ride to the wide sandy beach and the promenade.
nearbyVillageDescription: Cosy cafés, bakeries and restaurants, plus the charming Belle Époque Concessie district.
nearbyTramDescription: Hop on the Kusttram to explore the whole coast. Bruges and Ostend are also within easy reach.
